title: Properness survives base change and composition
statement:
The class of proper
morphisms is stable under base change and composition (the two
instances are [lem-weil-pbc-proper-base-change] and
[lem-weil-pbc-proper-composition]); in particular, if $X\to \Spec(k)$ is proper and $Y$ is any $k$-scheme, then the projection
$\operatorname{pr}_2:X\times_kY\to Y$ is proper.

proof.text: Stability under arbitrary base change is [lem-weil-pbc-proper-base-change], and stability under composition is [lem-weil-pbc-proper-composition]. For the last assertion, apply the base-change statement with $f:X\to\Spec(k)$ and $g:Y\to\Spec(k)$. Its conclusion is properness of $f':X\times_{\Spec(k)}Y\to Y$. By definition, $X\times_kY$ is this fibre product, and $f'$ is its second projection $\operatorname{pr}_2$, so the required projection is proper.
